summary: The PR addresses the issue of `tearDown` being called on skipped tests when using `--pdb`, but introduces a new function without updating related parts of the codebase.

issues.description: The introduction of `_is_skipped` function is not used consistently across all relevant parts of the codebase. For example, the `check_testcase_implements_trial_reporter` function is not modified to use this new function.
There are no additional tests added to verify the behavior of `tearDown` when a test is skipped with `--pdb` and the new `_is_skipped` function is used.
